_comment: V4 key-view vision gate. Blind reads: one PNG per task, no source, no sibling views, no expected answer; description then strict JSON {question_answered, action, blockers, confidence}. The blind image names are mapped below to the rendered view. Round 1 read all 9 key views; round 2 re-read the 6 views touched by the three legibility fixes; round 3 re-read the 3 KV3 views after the dual-scale fix. Transcripts are summarized faithfully from the @vision outputs; no image data was invented. Rounds 1-2 were rendered before the final text-only anchor/cap changes; the final_gate section is the authoritative read of the committed PNGs.
